mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID FROM tb_g2_user WHERE USER_ID=#{employeeId} FOR UPDATE

choose.when: SELECT f.*, c.ID AS cc_id, c.IS_READ, c.CC_TIME AS arrived_time FROM tb_approval_cc c JOIN tb_approval_flow_info f ON f.FLOW_ID=c.FLOW_ID c.TO_USER_ID=#{employeeId} ORDER BY c.CC_TIME DESC, c.ID DESC
choose.otherwise:
SELECT f.*, t.TASK_ID, t.TASK_STATUS, t.CREATE_TIME AS arrived_time, t.FINISH_TIME, n.LEVEL_NO FROM tb_approval_task t JOIN tb_approval_flow_info f ON f.FLOW_ID=t.FLOW_ID JOIN tb_approval_node_info n ON n.NODE_ID=t.NODE_ID AND n.FLOW_ID=t.FLOW_ID
t.APPROVER_ID=#{employeeId} AND
t.TASK_STATUS='1' AND f.FLOW_STATUS='1' AND n.NODE_STATUS='2' t.TASK_STATUS IN ('2','3')
ORDER BY t.CREATE_TIMEt.FINISH_TIME DESC, t.TASK_ID DESC

choose.when: SELECT a.USER_ID AS requester_id, a.ORGAN_ID, a.VAC_ID, u.USER_ATTR AS requester_attr, u.USER_NAME AS requester_name, u.USER_CODE, o.DEPT_NAME AS organ_name, a.FLOW_ID AS source_flow_id, a.APPROVE_STATUS, a.START_DATE AS start_time, a.END_DATE AS end_time, a.LEAVE_DAYS AS amount, '天' AS unit, a.REASON, v.VAC_NAME, v.VAC_SYMBOL AS symbol, '' AS extra_info FROM tb_at_vacation_apply a LEFT JOIN tb_g2_user u ON u.USER_ID=a.USER_ID LEFT JOIN tb_g2_organ o ON o.ORGAN_ID=a.ORGAN_ID LEFT JOIN tb_at_vacation_code v ON v.VAC_ID=a.VAC_ID WHERE a.APPLY_NO=#{bizNo}

SELECT a.USER_ID AS requester_id, a.ORGAN_ID, u.USER_ATTR AS requester_attr, u.USER_NAME AS requester_name, u.USER_CODE, o.DEPT_NAME AS organ_name, a.FLOW_ID AS source_flow_id, a.APPROVE_STATUS, CAST(a.WORK_DATE AS DATETIME) AS start_time, CAST(a.WORK_DATE AS DATETIME) AS end_time, 1 AS amount, '次' AS unit, a.REASON, '补打卡' AS vac_name, '补' AS symbol, CONCAT(CASE a.CARD_TYPE WHEN '1' THEN '上班卡' ELSE '下班卡' END, ' · 当月第', a.MONTH_COUNT, '次 · 门岗记录ID：', COALESCE(CAST(a.ACCESS_REC_ID AS CHAR),'未关联')) AS extra_info FROM tb_at_recard_apply a LEFT JOIN tb_g2_user u ON u.USER_ID=a.USER_ID LEFT JOIN tb_g2_organ o ON o.ORGAN_ID=a.ORGAN_ID WHERE a.APPLY_NO=#{bizNo}

SELECT a.APPLY_USER_ID AS requester_id, a.ORGAN_ID, u.USER_ATTR AS requester_attr, u.USER_NAME AS requester_name, u.USER_CODE, o.DEPT_NAME AS organ_name, a.FLOW_ID AS source_flow_id, a.APPROVE_STATUS, a.START_TIME, a.END_TIME, a.APPLY_HOURS AS amount, '小时' AS unit, a.REASON, '加班' AS vac_name, '加' AS symbol, '直属上级代申请' AS extra_info FROM tb_at_overtime_rec a LEFT JOIN tb_g2_user u ON u.USER_ID=a.APPLY_USER_ID LEFT JOIN tb_g2_organ o ON o.ORGAN_ID=a.ORGAN_ID WHERE a.APPLY_NO=#{bizNo}

SELECT a.USER_ID AS requester_id, a.ORGAN_ID, u.USER_ATTR AS requester_attr, u.USER_NAME AS requester_name, u.USER_CODE, o.DEPT_NAME AS organ_name, a.FLOW_ID AS source_flow_id, a.APPROVE_STATUS, a.START_DATE AS start_time, a.END_DATE AS end_time, a.REST_HOURS AS amount, '小时' AS unit, '' AS reason, '调休' AS vac_name, '调' AS symbol, '' AS extra_info FROM tb_at_pay_overtime_info a LEFT JOIN tb_g2_user u ON u.USER_ID=a.USER_ID LEFT JOIN tb_g2_organ o ON o.ORGAN_ID=a.ORGAN_ID WHERE a.APPLY_NO=#{bizNo}
